correctness.rationale: Noncrossing closure of a set T of positive queries is exactly the partition by components of the geometric union of closed chords: crossing equalities must merge, distinct component hulls cannot alternate by planar separation. The finest forced partition makes an arbitrary labeling realizable iff each negative chord is disconnected in G_T; by monotonicity it suffices to test S minus that chord. The graph cycle obstruction yields upper VC n-1; a noncrossing path attains it; equivalence-relation quotient induction bounds online Littlestone dimension. Triangle and crossing-fork three-query obstructions give exact layer count. Independent direct trace versus geometric closure enumerations agree n=3..6; n=7,8 tables are as provided finite enumerations only.
